title: Filtering the products table by text · part 3

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'apr' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %apr% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%apr%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%apr%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%apr%';

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Picholine Olive Oil 1L
